patthana9.3:1.1: na hetuṃ na vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:3.1: na hetuṃ na nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka naupādinnupādāniyattikaṃ
patthana9.3:4.1: na hetuṃ na upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:5.1: na hetuṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:6.1: na hetuṃ na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattikaṃ
patthana9.3:7.1: na hetuṃ na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:8.1: na hetuṃ na asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:9.1: na hetuṃ na asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka navitakkattikaṃ
patthana9.3:10.1: na hetuṃ na savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:11.1: na hetuṃ na avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:12.1: na hetuṃ na avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka napītittikaṃ
patthana9.3:13.1: na hetuṃ na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:14.1: na hetuṃ na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:15.1: na hetuṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka nadassanattikaṃ
patthana9.3:16.1: na hetuṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:17.1: na hetuṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:18.1: na hetuṃ na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka nadassanenapahātabbahetukattikaṃ
patthana9.3:19.1: na hetuṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:20.1: na hetuṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana9.3:21.1: na hetuṃ na nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na hetuduka naācayagāmittikaṃ
